claims.text: Starts with tingling, itching, or burning
claims.quote: A cold sore usually starts with a tingling, itching or burning feeling.

claims.text: Blisters appear over the next 48 hours
claims.quote: Over the next 48 hours one or more painful blisters will appear on your face.

claims.text: Blisters burst and crust over into a scab
claims.quote: The blisters burst and crust over into a scab.

claims.text: Should start to heal within 10 days; contagious while healing
claims.quote: Cold sores should start to heal within 10 days, but are contagious and may be irritating or painful while they heal.

claims.text: Contagious from the first tingle until completely healed
claims.quote: Cold sores are contagious from the moment you first feel tingling or other signs of a cold sore coming on ... when the cold sore has completely healed.

claims.text: Do not kiss; no oral sex until healed; do not kiss babies (neonatal herpes)
claims.quote: do not kiss anyone while you have a cold sore ... do not have oral sex until your cold sore completely heals ... Kissing a baby if you have a cold sore can lead to neonatal herpes

claims.text: Do not touch except to apply cream; wash hands; dab, do not rub
claims.quote: do not touch your cold sore (apart from applying antiviral cream) ... wash your hands before and after ... do not rub cream into the cold sore

claims.text: Antiviral creams: start at the tingle; may not work after blisters appear
claims.quote: use antiviral creams as soon as you recognise the early tingling feeling. ... They do not always work after blisters appear.

claims.text: Pain relief, fluids, avoid acidic or salty food, avoid triggers such as sunbeds
claims.quote: take paracetamol or ibuprofen to ease pain and swelling ... drink plenty of fluids ... do not eat acidic or salty food if it makes your cold sore feel worse ... sunbeds

claims.text: See a GP: not healing in 10 days, very large or painful, weakened immune system
claims.quote: a cold sore has not started to heal within 10 days ... the cold sore is very large or painful ... you have a weakened immune system

claims.text: The virus stays for life
claims.quote: Once you have the virus, it stays in your skin for the rest of your life.

claims.text: Many cold sores go away without treatment in 7 to 14 days
claims.quote: For many people, a cold sore goes away without treatment in 7 to14 days.

claims.text: Sun protection helps healing and prevents new blisters; SPF 30 or higher lip balm
claims.quote: Protecting your lips from the sun can help heal and prevent new blisters. ... Wearing lip balm year-round that has SPF 30 or higher and broad-spectrum protection may help prevent new cold sores.

claims.text: Throw away lip balm and lipstick used during the sore
claims.quote: After your cold sore clears, throw away products like lip balm and lipstick that you used while you had a cold sore.

claims.text: See a dermatologist: eczema, near an eye, several sores or lots of pain, longer than 2 weeks, 6 or more a year, weakened immune system
claims.quote: Have atopic dermatitis ... Develop a cold sore near an eye, several cold sores, or lots of pain ... lasts longer than 2 weeks ... Get cold sores 6 or more times per year

claims.text: Weakened immune system examples: transplant medicines, cancer or HIV, chemotherapy
claims.quote: Take medication that weakens your immune system, like medication prescribed after an organ transplant ... like cancer or HIV ... like chemotherapy

claims.quote: The 2-day regimen did not offer additional benefit over the 1-day regimen.

claims.text: Participants were given the medicine and told to start at the first symptoms; regimens tested

claims.quote: In study 1, the median duration of the episode (primary endpoint) was reduced by 1.0 day (P = 0.001) with 1-day treatment and 0.5 days (P = 0.009) with 2-day treatment compared to placebo.

claims.quote: The time to lesion healing and time to cessation of pain and/or discomfort were statistically significantly reduced with valacyclovir compared to placebo. In study 2, results similar to those in study 1 were obtained.

claims.text: The trials did not test starting after blisters formed (all started at first symptoms)
